quotations.old_english: Pyles tácen is þæt þú mid þínum scytefingre sume feþer tácnum gestríce on þýne wynstran hand innewearde and lecge tó þínum eáron
Bið se elnboga underléd mid pyle
Genim þás wyrte, lege him nytendum under his pyle

source_text: pyle. In l. 8 for seti l. setl, and add: pylu :-- Pylu ceruical, An. Ox. 29, 4. Pyles tácen is þæt þú mid þínum scytefingre sume feþer tácnum gestríce on þýne wynstran hand innewearde and lecge tó þínum eáron, Tech. ii. 126, 6. Bið se elnboga underléd mid pyle, Past. 143, 18. Genim þás wyrte, lege him nytendum under his pyle, Lch. i. 228, 1. [N. E. D. pillow.] v. heáfod-pyle.
